title: Ghost Town
summary: After two months of flying, Xiao Yan reaches Ghost Town on the Jia Ma Empire's border. There Meng Li, backed by the Misty Cloud elder Yun Fan, is trying to seize military command from the commander Mu Tie. Xiao Yan steps in, his followers crush the Misty Cloud force, and he runs down a fleeing Misty Cloud man until he surrenders. Mu Tie, who once let Xiao Yan escape, explains how the Misty Cloud Sect grew, attacked the Xiao Clan, and pushed Yun Yun out as leader. He adds that Ya Fei now heads the Mite'er family and that Yun Shan will strike them first. In the Misty Cloud Sect, Yun Shan orders Ghost Town taken within five days and readies his men against the Mite'er family. Xiao Yan hurries to the capital.
